name: Swainson's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Far northeastern sudan to ethiopia, northern somalia, and north-central kenya
description: A drab sparrow of northeastern Africa. The head and underparts are gray, the wing and back are brown, and the rump is rufous.

name: Yellow-eared Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southeastern brazil (southeastern bahia to rio de janeiro)
description: Small, short-billed woodpecker with an olive-green back, a yellow nape, and a gray face. Heavily barred below and on the tail.

name: Sombre Nightjar
rangeDescription: Ethiopia to northwestern somalia, southwestern kenya, and northeastern tanzania
description: A medium-sized typical nightjar with a golden-buff collar. Both sexes have small pale marks in the outer wings and at the corners of the tail.

name: Wetar Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (timor and wetar)
description: A fairly large ground-dwelling forest dove. Male is mostly dark with a diagnostic pale head and breast.

name: Sri Lanka Wood-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Sri lanka
description: Large, plain gray pigeon with conspicuous black-and-white stripes on the nape. Underparts flushed mauve.

name: Drab Seedeater
rangeDescription: Arid southern ecuador; upper marañón valley of northern peru southward to ica
description: Well-named seedeater found in arid scrub and adjacent farmland in western Peru and southwestern Ecuador. Its best field marks are the distinct wingbars and bill color (pinkish on breeding males, nearly black on other individuals).

name: Papuan Whipbird
rangeDescription: New guinea (snow and weyland mountains)
description: A rare and little known, medium-sized bird of montane forests. Overall olive-green plumage with a longish tail which is often held cocked.

name: Red-tailed Vanga
rangeDescription: Forested regions of madagascar
description: Small vanga that is built like a chickadee or tit. Male is colorful and female plain brownish.

name: Venezuelan Wood-Quail
rangeDescription: Western venezuela (southwestern táchira) and coastal cordillera eastward to miranda
description: A robust and beautiful forest-dwelling quail with a short crest and a stout bill. Mostly rufous-brown body, boldly scaled white below and streaked white above.
imageCreditName: Jhonathan Miranda - Wandering Venezuela Birding Expeditions

name: Mountain Avocetbill
rangeDescription: Central andes of colombia to northern peru (amazonas to la libertad)
description: Scarce Andean hummingbird with a short, awl-like bill that is upturned at the tip. Mostly green, and streaked with white on the underparts; also note the buff tinge to belly and white spot behind the eye.

name: Antipodes Parakeet
rangeDescription: Locally in antipodes islands
description: Entirely green parakeet endemic to the subantarctic Antipodes Islands. The largest of New Zealand’s native parakeets.

name: Philippine Leafbird
rangeDescription: Central and southern philippines (cebu, leyte, and mindanao)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland and foothill forest canopy and edge. Overall bright green with a paler green chest and face and a yellowish throat, eye-ring, and edge to the wing.

name: Andean Lapwing
rangeDescription: Andes of southwestern colombia to northwestern argentina and northern chile
description: Large, boldly patterned shorebird of high Andean bogs, wetlands, and lakeshores; also ranges into grassy pastures in the northern part of its range. Usually in pairs or loose flocks, feeding with typical stop-start action of plovers.

name: Madagascar Buzzard
rangeDescription: Woodland and savanna of madagascar
description: Typical brown buzzard that is endemic to Madagascar. Found throughout the island in many different habitats, though absent from pure grassland.

name: Rufous-bellied Bush-Tyrant
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern peru (pasco) to western bolivia
description: Subtly patterned reddish-brown flycatcher of high-elevation montane forests. Perches upright, often on the tops of snags or bushes around forest edges and clearings.

name: Xinjiang Ground-Jay
rangeDescription: Desert of northwestern china (western xinjiang)
description: Odd-looking corvid which brings to mind a ground-dwelling desert nutcracker. Pale brownish overall, with black-and-white wing and a thick black mustache which broadens and curves up towards the face.

name: Xingu Scythebill
rangeDescription: Eastern amazonian brazil between the rio xingu and rio tocantins
description: A brown, tree-climbing bird with a strongly curved bill. Appears small-headed; plumage is mostly rufous-brown with buffy streaking on head and neck.

name: Gray-sided Thrush
rangeDescription: Mountains of northeastern china (liaoning); winters to india and myanmar
description: A dull brown thrush with a gray belly and white eyebrows. Head pattern similar to that of Eyebrowed Thrush, but Gray-sided has no orange tones anywhere on the body.

name: Ross's Goose
rangeDescription: Breeds tundra of arctic north-central canada; winters to western and central usa and central mexico
description: Cute miniature version of Snow Goose with smaller body, shorter neck, and stubbier bill. Pay special attention to the bill: short, with a straighter border where it meets the face, a much less obvious dark “grin patch,” and often bluish-gray color at the base.

name: Tacarcuna Chlorospingus
rangeDescription: Montane forest of eastern panama and far northwestern colombia
description: Fairly small tanager-like sparrow with an extremely tiny range in Panama. Occurs in humid forests from around 800–1,500 m.
